    lower=[v for r in inp[bar+1:] for v in r if v!=0 and v!=5]

def f(inp):
    bar=[r for r in range(len(inp)) if all(x==5 for x in inp[r])][0]
    h=len(inp)-bar-1
    # components above bar, excluding colors 1 and 5
    topcomps=[]
    for c in range(2,10):
        pl=[(r,j) for r in range(bar) for j in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[r][j]==c]
        for cp in comps8(pl): topcomps.append((cp,c))
    surv=max(topcomps,key=lambda o:(o[1],max(p[1] for p in o[0])))[0]
    # kept object: most common non-background,non-5 color in lower band
    lower=[v for r in inp[bar+1:] for v in r if v!=0 and v!=5]
    from collections import Counter
    kc=Counter(lower).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bot=comps8([(r,j) for r in range(bar+1,len(inp)) for j in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[r][j]==kc])[0]
